note: Phase 6 closes NOTHING, and says so rather than closing on a recorded differential. It owns 433 function rows and 531 data objects; 129 of the function rows are reconstructed with a proof, 304 are not reconstructed, and no data object is dispositioned. The schema accepts one thing as a closure -- a mutation aimed at the row that the gate catches -- and Phase 6 has no per-row mutation evidence. Closing these 129 rows on their recorded differentials would be the unfounded closure 3z264 found.

proof_kinds.differential_falsified: a mutation aimed at this row in a throwaway archive copy, rebuilt, and run against the committed oracle transcript through a registered staged-pair target. Phase 6 has none yet.
proof_kinds.static_proof_falsified: a mutation aimed at the row and caught by a static check rather than a differential. Phase 6 has none yet.

deferred_reasons.not_reconstructed_in_phase: Phase 6 did not reconstruct this row and names nothing that blocks it. A debt, not an obstruction.
deferred_reasons.reconstructed_not_falsified: the row is reconstructed and carries a recorded proof, but no mutation has been aimed at it. This is the work Phase 6 has left: 129 rows, each needing one mutation and one measured detection.
deferred_reasons.data_object_not_dispositioned: no closure schema lets any phase close a data object, so the data half arrives here by construction.

entry_points: NxJointDesc_SetGlobalAnchor (0x000980b0) and NxJointDesc_SetGlobalAxis (0x000982e0), resolved by GetProcAddress against the staged pair

differentials: NxPhysicsJointDescTests: four cases over the two exported joint-descriptor rows, printing the whole descriptor surface. Built and run, NOT registered, because it is not green against the whole candidate pair on the degenerate axis.
NxPhysicsObjectLayoutTests: the guardedstore, tailjmp, mutexlistfree, mutexfamily and mutexdirect families drive the joint rows the census records as reconstructed
